conclusion: For ~173-positive targets the OOF AUC carries material model-fit variance; a single flipped training positive moves AUC by ~0.03. Any timely_second-vs-final_msmi AUC gap of that order is NOT evidence of signal attenuation.

evaluation_side.note: Swapping only the EVALUATION target (1 label) moves AUC by <=0.001 for a fixed model.

training_side.note: Two models whose TRAINING labels differ by a single row yield correlated-but-distinct scores; the same-evaluation-label AUC gap is therefore model-fit instability, not signal loss.
